source.title: Training objectives and inference interventions on 12,831 nuPlan scenes with full-scene evaluation

protocol.dataset_detail: filtered nuPlan test scenes outside Pittsburgh (Las Vegas, Boston, Singapore)
protocol.evaluated_population: all generated vehicles of each scene, stationary vehicles included
protocol.spatial_scope: full generated scene (75 m-radius map context), no evaluation crop
protocol.conditioning: recorded agent counts and types of each scene; no sampling-time guidance, rejection or repair
protocol.seed_aggregation: one generation seed per model; mean and sample SD (n - 1) across the three training seeds

uncertainty.note: Sample standard deviation across training seeds; not a confidence interval. A reported 0.0000 is a rounded value, not proof of zero variance.

metrics.label: Nearest
metrics.name: Nearest-agent distance JSD
metrics.definition: Jensen-Shannon divergence between generated and recorded histograms of the distance to the nearest agent (1 m bins over 0-150 m); dimensionless, unscaled.

metrics.label: Lateral
metrics.name: Lateral deviation JSD
metrics.definition: Jensen-Shannon divergence of the lateral deviation from the lane (0.1 m bins over 0-4.5 m); dimensionless, unscaled.

metrics.label: Angular
metrics.name: Angular deviation JSD
metrics.definition: Jensen-Shannon divergence of the angular deviation from the lane direction; dimensionless, unscaled.

metrics.label: Collision
metrics.name: Vehicle collision rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of evaluated vehicles involved in at least one oriented-box intersection; each vehicle counted once; stationary vehicles included.

metrics.label: Off-road
metrics.name: Lane/heading off-road rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of evaluated vehicles with no lane polygon that contains the center with a heading difference of at most 30 degrees; stationary vehicles included. Not the official drivable-area membership check.

metrics.label: Fully-valid
metrics.name: Fully-valid scene rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of scenes with neither a collision nor a lane/heading off-road violation. Not a statement about future motion.

notes: JSD values are unscaled and dimensionless; percentages are percentage values, not fractions.
Effects are metric-dependent: not every validity or fidelity metric improves.
Do not pool these rows with the one-seed DDPM-1000 controls or with the guided / rejection / repair rows of Table VIII.
Full-scene rates must not be compared with the cropped +/-32 m rates of Table IX as if only the city changed.

source.title: Generalization to held-out Pittsburgh: 5,622 scenes, +/-32 m, DDPM-1000

protocol.dataset_detail: all Pittsburgh scenes of the filtered nuPlan test set
protocol.held_out_status: Pittsburgh is excluded from SFiD (D, Full) training, validation and normalization; the released SD-L checkpoint was trained with Pittsburgh included
protocol.evaluated_population: vehicles whose center lies inside the window; stationary vehicles included
protocol.spatial_scope: ego-centered square |x|, |y| <= 32 m, applied after generation with the 75 m-radius map context
protocol.conditioning: D / Full: recorded agent counts and types fixed before cropping; SD-L keeps its own count/type handling and generation interface
protocol.sampler_detail: ancestral DDPM, 1000 steps (D, Full); SD-L uses its released sampler
protocol.seed_aggregation: D / Full: average the three generation seeds within each training seed, then mean and sample SD (n - 1) across the three training seeds; SD-L: one run of the released checkpoint

uncertainty.note: Sample standard deviation across training seeds after averaging three generation seeds per training seed; not a confidence interval. No SD is reported for SD-L (single run).

metrics.label: Nearest

source.title: Eight-second rollouts on 500 Pittsburgh scenes using the same Flow-ERD model

protocol.aggregation: unique vehicles colliding with another non-ego vehicle at least once over 8 seconds; average per-scene rates over eligible scenes, then across training seeds
protocol.dataset_detail: 500 Pittsburgh scenes sampled from the held-out Pittsburgh evaluation set
protocol.initial_states: initializer output of each scene (generation seed 1234) cropped to non-ego vehicles within the +/-32 m window; the recorded ego initial state is shared by all initializers
protocol.simulation: sixteen consecutive 0.5 s blocks with state feedback, 10 Hz trajectory output; all agents including the ego advance
protocol.behavior_seed: one behavior-model sampling seed per scene, identical for every initializer
protocol.seed_aggregation: per-scene vehicle fraction averaged equally over eligible (non-empty) scenes, then mean and sample SD (n - 1) across the three initializer training seeds

uncertainty.note: Sample standard deviation across initializer training seeds; not a confidence interval. No SD is reported for Real and SD-L (single runs).

metric.label: Eight-second vehicle collision
metric.name: Eight-second rollout vehicle collision rate
metric.definition: Distinct non-ego vehicles whose box overlaps another non-ego vehicle box at least once during the eight-second rollout, divided by the non-ego vehicle count of the scene, averaged equally over eligible scenes; a vehicle is counted once; initially overlapping vehicles are included if they also overlap during the rollout.

reference_models.note: Single run started from the recorded layout of each scene; no SD is reported and none must be substituted.
Single run of the released checkpoint; no SD is reported and none must be substituted. Pittsburgh was part of the SD-L training data, so this row is not a held-out result for SD-L.

notes: The metric concerns non-ego vehicles only.

Table XI separately reports initial collision-scene rates (scenes with any initial overlap divided by all 500 scenes): a different metric with a different denominator, not interchangeable with this vehicle collision rate.
Initialization is one contributor to rollout validity; the behavior model also matters, and Real-initialized rollouts also show non-zero collisions.

verification.scope_note: Counts refer to the cells contained in this file. The underlying cross-check covered all 8 cells of Table XI (Real, SD-L, D, Full x initial collision scenes, vehicle collision).
